items.prompt: Public prerequisite pair (1,2) means course 2 precedes course 1. Which stored edge is correct?

options.why: That reverses the declared after,before interpretation.
A prerequisite relation is directed, not an undirected connection.

options.text: No edge, because course numbers are already ordered.
options.why: Numeric order does not eliminate a prerequisite.
The prerequisite points to the course it enables.

items.explanation: The prerequisite points to the course it enables.
